title_sq: Apartament ne shitje 2+1 tek Univers City!
description_sq:
Apartament ne shitje 2+1 tek Univers City!
- I ndodhur ne nje prej zonave me te zhvilluara te qytetit, shume prane qendres tregtare QTU, kompleksi "Univers City" eshte projekti me i madh urban ne Tirane me sukses te garantuar, ndertim i nje prej kompanive me ne emer ne treg.
- Univers City përbëhet nga ndërtesa me njësi të shumëllojshme banimi dhe shërbimi si dhe infrastrukturë të plotë për një jetesë komode në një komunitet rezidencial.
- Apartamenti eshte i tipologjise 2+1, me nje siperfaqe totale prej 129m2, nje planimetri perfekte dhe organizim te rregullt, ku hyrja realizohet nepermjet nje korridori shperndares per ne dhomen e ndenjes, 2 dhomat e gjumit , tualeti dhe ballkoni ne trajten e nje verande i orientuar jug lindje.
Objekti ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti eshte i perfunduar dhe gati per banim!
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 in Univers City!
description_en: Apartment for sale 2+1 in Univers City! - Located in one of the most developed areas of the city, very close to the QTU shopping center, the "Univers City" complex is the largest urban project in Tirana with guaranteed success, built by one of the most renowned companies in the market. - Univers City consists of buildings with various residential and service units as well as complete infrastructure for a comfortable living in a residential community. - The apartment is of the 2+1 typology, with a total area of ​​129m2, a perfect layout and regular organization, where the entrance is made through a distribution corridor to the living room, the 2 bedrooms, the toilet and the balcony in the form of a south-east oriented veranda. The building in which the apartment is located is finished and ready for occupancy! For more information contact!
